about: A refused chess.com country lookup (the harness aborts every api.chess.com request) is not stored in ct_country, the review left and opened again asks again for both players, a stored answer paints its flag picture before the name (lowercase 'us' read as US) and sends no lookup, and a value that is not a two-letter code paints nothing. Graded by gate 227 (TC-R376, TC-R377) at kunal761 and 320x568; gate 20 keeps TC-R68/TC-R107 at 375x730. NOT COVERED: the lichess branch (same code path, by reading); a real chess.com answer (the endpoint is blocked here); Kunal's own phone.

breaks.name: a-refused-lookup-is-cached-again
breaks.why: fetchCountry stores its result on every exit path again, so a refused lookup is cached as '' (no country) and never asked again - the job's defect

breaks.name: a-missing-entry-reads-as-no-country
breaks.why: countryCacheGet answers '' for a player it holds nothing for, so the reader cannot tell 'never asked' from 'no country' and no lookup is ever sent

breaks.name: the-flag-paints-over-the-name
breaks.why: the flag picture is taken out of the row (position absolute), so it paints over the start of the name instead of before it and the names do not move
